scope: Picker producer → per-tab injection/cancellation queue → service-worker relay → ListPatternTab consumer; identical tab and URL replacement session.
authorship: No product source or test edits. This reviewer previously held the live-verification seat for D39/D40; D42 itself received no live observation.

live_verification.evidence: No browser or test/build tools were used in this review. The retained Microdata Event recipe is unrelated to D42 and remains available for future live work.
live_verification.required_next_proof: On the fresh installed artifact, start A, cancel it, start B on the same tab and URL, then deliver A detection/result/exit and delayed A cancellation separately. Require unchanged B config/picking state, followed by successful B detection, field selection and extraction. Reinject the content context and verify one event per click and normal page clicks after close.

reasoning: ListPatternTab creates a unique UUID per start, stores current tab/page/session identity, invalidates refs before dispatching targeted cancellation, and accepts rebroadcasts only when tab_id, session_id and current page key all match (src/features/showcase/tabs/ListPatternTab.tsx:93-106,165-170).

Start and cancel executeScript operations are serialized per tab; cancellation carries the old UUID. Therefore a queued A cancel cannot overtake B start, and if delivered after B is active the page hook only cancels when the target equals its current session (src/lib/data-pattern/list-picker-session.ts:13-57; src/lib/data-pattern/list-picker.ts:102-105).

Detection, result and exit carry producer session_id. The relay preserves that identity while replacing tab_id with the trusted sender's tab; the consumer rejects non-current sessions before changing the builder (src/lib/data-pattern/list-picker.ts:181-190,306-318; src/lib/data-pattern/list-picker-relay.ts:4-16; ListPatternTab.tsx:165-228).

Reinjection calls the previous context teardown before replacing the overlay; teardown removes that context's document capture listeners and resets picker state (src/lib/data-pattern/list-picker.ts:39-50,112-128).

A parameterized consumer-level regression test injects each stale A channel after B starts, confirms B remains in picking state, then delivers current B RESULT and asserts Extract returns Neon Nights data (tests/unit/showcase-doctor-list-handoff.test.tsx:133-172).
test_proof_gaps: Cross-context reinjection tests count one detection and verify a later ordinary click is not prevented, but do not exercise the full sequence with a pending old message plus a replacement picker.

The parameterized Showcase handoff test does assert current B RESULT → Extract → Neon Nights rows after a stale A channel, separately for stale detection/result/exit. It uses mocked message delivery and page execution; it does not include the real producer and service-worker relay in that same composition.
source_quality.limitations: This is static source analysis only. No tests were run and no runtime outcome is claimed. It does not promote EXT-D-0042 to verified or closed.
